bullets.title: MRVL Investor Day: FY31 revenue target $70-90B, stock +8% intraday
bullets.body: Marvell raised FY28 revenue guidance to $20B (vs. prior $18B and FactSet $18.17B consensus) and introduced FY31 guidance of $70-90B (55-60% CAGR), well above FactSet's $47B. Custom revenue target raised to $12B for FY29 (3x FY28→FY29 growth), TAM expanded to $400B by CY30. Hedgeye maintains top pick with $1T valuation thesis; Wolfe hosting MRVL IR meeting at OCP Summit Oct 12.

bullets.title: AFRM: Citi bullish into Nov 5 earnings — 27-30% GMV growth, new AI model adds 170bps
bullets.body: Citi expects 27-30% YoY GMV growth (potentially 400bps above high-end guidance) driven by robust pipeline including Intuit/QuickBooks, Amazon UK, and ServiceTitan. New transformer underwriting model live at U.S. checkout generates 3.4% more completed purchases (~$1.1B incremental annual GMV). Rate sensitivity manageable at ~40bps RLTC per 100bps funding cost; FY27 RLTC margin of 4.16% holds above 4% floor even after headwinds.

bullets.title: AMD PT raised to $705, SNDK $2,050, DELL $650 by Mizuho on agentic AI CPU TAM
bullets.body: Mizuho raises AMD target to $705 (from $580) on agentic AI driving CPU TAM from $68B in 2026 to $209B by 2030 (32% CAGR), with agentic CPU reaching $80B. SNDK PT raised to $2,050 (from $1,875) as 18% of NAND demand driven by agentic AI by 2030; DELL PT raised to $650 (from $600). INTC PT raised to $114 from $92 despite Neutral; ARM, MU, NVDA PTs unchanged at $400/$1,400/$315 all Outperform.

bullets.title: MU: JPM sees CY27-28 supply significantly tighter; buyback pivot imminent
bullets.body: JPM flags CY27 and CY28 DRAM/NAND supply significantly tighter than CY26, with demand growth well above industry supply growth rates (low-20s DRAM, mid-20s NAND). FY27 gross margin floor expected to be established at November quarter earnings. MU seeking materially larger buyback authorization with plan for 100% excess cash return over time; CY27 HBM prices reset significantly higher vs. CY26.

bullets.title: CEG +10% pre-market on 15-yr 2.7GW + 20-yr 890MW nuclear PPA with Google
bullets.body: Constellation Energy signed a 15-year energy supply agreement for 2.7 GW in PJM plus a 20-year, 890 MW new nuclear PPA with Google, enabling $4.3B+ in new equipment investments across 11 nuclear units in IL, PA, and NJ. Third major PJM power deal in 2026 without 1-for-1 new generation requirement. Sympathy movers pre-market: TLN +5.2%, VST +4.6%, OKLO +3.8%, SMR +2.7%.

bullets.title: SHOP: JPM raises PT to $200; agentic commerce AI traffic 2x traditional channels
bullets.body: JPM reiterates OW on SHOP, raising PT to $200 (from $185) targeting ~23x 2028E gross profit of $10.9B. Model shows 2027E revenue growth ~27% with payment economics preserved through SHOP rails. Agentic AI traffic additive at ~2x traditional channels; SHOP positioned across agentic commerce value chain.

bullets.title: NVDA, AMD, TSM hitting 52-week highs; semis (SMH +6% w/w) leading market
bullets.body: NVDA hit 52-week high at $242.40 (+29.2% YTD, +1.5% on day); AMD at 52-week high +290.5% YTD at $643; TSM breaking ATHs ahead of earnings in 10 days with GS raising 2027-28 capex forecasts to $85B/$98B. SMH rallied 6% w/w led by AMAT +11%, KLAC +9%, TSM +7%, NVDA +4%; options skew at 5th percentile indicating continued bullishness.

bullets.title: NVDA AI switch share declining; CLS/CSCO gaining in AI networking vs ANET
bullets.body: NVDA's AI DC switch share fell to 44% in 2Q26 from 48% in 1Q26; CLS at 18%, CSCO at 10% and surging. ANET DC Ethernet share fell to 20% from 22% while CSCO at 19%, CLS at 17% closing gap. CRDO maintains 81% AEC dominance despite 121% YoY market growth. JPM raised DC Ethernet Switch TAM estimates +6%/+18%/+25% for 2026-28.

bullets.title: MSFT, META, AMZN, GOOGL, ORCL bond issuance = 14% of net new Treasury supply
bullets.body: Hyperscaler cumulative bond issuance since 2023 equals ~14% of net new Treasury borrowing over past 12 months, with 31% of deals targeting 30yr+ maturities. 10yr Treasury yields rise ~5.4bps more in months following hyperscaler deals vs. non-deal days. Continued capex expansion and weakening FCF-to-debt coverage suggest sustained upward pressure on long-term yields.

bullets.title: BE, TSLA top distributed power picks; MS forecasts $240B BTM power TAM through 2029
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley forecasts ~120 GW ($240B) behind-the-meter power equipment TAM through 2029 (77 GW data center + 40 GW C&I). Bloom Energy SOFC ranks #1, BorgWarner Turbine Generator #2, FTAI aeroderivative #3 on MS scorecard. Tesla and BorgWarner identified as key ESS/VPP providers; US ESS deployments forecast to reach 279 GWh in 2030 including 169 GWh annual data-center demand.

bullets.title: ELF expanding into fragrance/body care (POP line) with $70-80B+ TAM, launching Jan 2027
bullets.body: ELF Beauty is launching the 'e.l.f. POP' fragrance and body care line as a permanent category in January 2027, expanding addressable market by $70-80B+ globally. Launch coincides with distribution whitespace in existing retail footprint. Hedgeye bullish on category expansion thesis.

bullets.title: NFLX down 5 weeks, RSI 32 (near oversold); GS flags engagement debate not resolved at earnings
bullets.body: NFLX has declined 5 consecutive weeks with 14-day RSI at 32, near oversold territory. Goldman notes investor sentiment is decidedly out of favor and earnings are 'unlikely to de-bunk engagement debate' — company must improve content mix (live/events) rather than rely on pure scale. GS views content strategy shift as necessary catalyst for re-rating.

bullets.title: T announces fiber JV with GIP/CPP Investments; expects to hit 2.5x leverage within ~3 years
bullets.body: AT&T forming wholesale fiber JV with Global Infrastructure Partners and CPP Investments, retaining 50% ownership. JV includes Forged Fiber 37 (acquired from Lumen) and existing Gigapower JV. Proceeds target 2.5x net-debt-to-adjusted-EBITDA within ~3 years; transaction expected to close H1 2027.

bullets.title: APP -14% on day; Morgan Stanley rates Internet sector Attractive entering 4Q
bullets.body: AppLovin down 14% on the session; also facing a San Diego County lawsuit over data harvesting and explicit ads shown in children's games. Internet sector broadly: AMZN +1%, ABNB +3%, UBER -2%, META -3%. AMZN/GOOGL/META trading at 19x/17x/23x 2026 EPS; AMZN/GOOGL multiples down 35%/33% vs TTM avg. MS rates Internet sector Attractive heading into 4Q.

bullets.title: SNAP: Activist Blue Duck Capital urges Specs capital raise; sees stock doubling to $12-14
bullets.body: Blue Duck Capital issued open letter to SNAP board urging a dedicated external capital raise (from VCs or strategic partner) for the Specs unit without diluting existing shareholders. Blue Duck believes this could unlock re-rating to $12-14 vs. current price of $5.61 — implying ~2x upside.

bullets.title: WBD/PSKY: Paramount completes acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery
bullets.body: Paramount (PSKY) completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery following antitrust settlement with states. WBD stock trading at $30.95.

bullets.title: MU hit with $600M Netlist patent settlement on HBM chips
bullets.body: Micron agreed to pay Netlist $600M to settle a patent dispute over HBM chips. This is an incremental negative headline though no analyst revisions flagged in the window.

bullets.title: WYNN: UBS cuts PT to $136 on Vegas/Macau/Boston weakness; Buy maintained
bullets.body: UBS cut Q3 Vegas EBITDA estimate 11% to $173M (down 15% YoY) after August Las Vegas gaming revenue ex-baccarat fell 6% YoY. Macau market GGR declined 3.8% YoY for 4 consecutive months vs. UBS estimate of -1%; Encore Boston Harbor labor strike (began Sept 4) adds further downside to $54M Q3 EBITDA estimate. PT cut to $136 from $138; Buy rating maintained.

bullets.title: ABNB CEO rejects third-party AI agent bookings; sees agentic AI as distribution cost reducer
bullets.body: Airbnb CEO Chesky stated the platform will 'probably not' allow third-party AI agents like Meta's Muse to directly book stays. Separately, PEB and CHH managements (post-meetings with Morgan Stanley) see agentic AI as a lower-cost distribution channel reducing customer acquisition costs. PEB paid search spend already down 20-25%.

bullets.title: STX/WDC: STX -2.2%, WDC -2.6% pre-market on TDK magnetic heads M&A competition
bullets.body: Seagate and Toshiba are competing to acquire TDK's HDD magnetic heads business. Mizuho's Klein is bullish on STX on the pullback, noting the acquisition would create margin leverage and supply chain control. WDC is not at risk as it manufactures magnetic heads internally.
